NASK is hiring a Software Engineer to develop user-facing applications and interfaces supporting national security missions. The role includes building data visualizations, integrating front-end applications with APIs and backend systems, and collaborating with engineers, analysts, and mission users to improve software usability and effectiveness.
Cyber Security
Telecom & Communications
Internet
Network Security
No H1B
Security Clearance Required
U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain user-facing software applications supporting national security missions
Build responsive, intuitive, and mission-focused user interfaces using modern web technologies and GUI frameworks
Translate operational and user requirements into clean, intuitive, and effective UI/UX solutions
Develop reusable UI components, application workflows, dashboards, and interactive data visualizations
Integrate front-end applications with RESTful APIs, backend services, databases, analytics platforms, and mission systems
Work closely with engineers, analysts, and mission users to understand workflows and improve the usability and effectiveness of software tools
Develop and maintain supporting backend services and APIs as needed to enable front-end functionality
Optimize applications for performance, responsiveness, reliability, accessibility, and maintainability
Troubleshoot and resolve UI, integration, and application-level defects across the software stack
Participate in code reviews, architecture and design discussions, Agile development activities, and collaborative development
Contribute to automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices
Support deployment and operation of applications in Linux-based environments

Experience optimizing UI/application performance and responsiveness
Experience with multi-threaded or real-time applications
Knowledge of signal processing, analytics, or data-intensive applications
XMIDAS experience

A competitive benefits package that equates to 50% on top of your annual base salary, split between a tax-qualified profit-sharing retirement plan that NASK contributes to (up to allowable IRS limits) and a cafeteria plan for benefits.

A casual yet professional work environment.
